verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a native Risk Register that replaces spreadsheets, with 4×4 or 5×5 risk scoring configurations and tracking, evaluation and remediation of risk. Risks can be assigned to owners via a dedicated role, and controls and action items are linked to those risks, which covers scoring, ownership, control linkage and action-item-based treatment. missing for 10: evidence of periodic risk review cycles or reminders, explicit treatment-plan fields (accept/mitigate/transfer), in-depth help-center documentation beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
